paragraphs: Graham Corporation ("we," "us," "our" or the "Company") is a global leader in the design and manufacture of mission critical fluid, power, heat transfer, vacuum, and advanced mixing technologies for the Defense, Energy & Process, and Space industries. For the Defense industry, our equipment is used in nuclear and non-nuclear propulsion, power, fluid transfer, thermal management, and advanced mixing systems. For the Energy & Process industries we supply equipment for vacuum, heat transfer, advanced mixing, and fluid transfer applications used in oil refining, downstream chemical facilities, fertilizers, ethylene, methanol, energetics, edible oil, food & beverage, pulp & paper, medical, and multiple alternative energy applications such as hydrogen, small modular nuclear, concentrated solar, lithium extraction, and geothermal processes. For the Space industry, our equipment is used in propulsion, power, thermal management, advanced mixing, and life support systems.

Our brands are built upon engineering expertise and close customer collaboration to design, develop, and produce mission critical equipment and systems that enable our customers to meet their economic and operational objectives. Continual improvement of our processes and systems to ensure qualified and compliant equipment are hallmarks of our brand. Our early engagement with customers and support until the end of service life are values upon which our brands are built.

Our corporate headquarters is co-located with our production facilities in Batavia, NY, and we have wholly-owned subsidiaries in Arvada, CO, Greenville, SC, Jupiter, FL, and Louisville, CO and have sales and engineering offices in Houston, TX, Suzhou, China and Ahmedabad and Pune, India.

We were incorporated in Delaware in 1983 and are the successor to Graham Manufacturing Co., Inc., which was incorporated in New York in 1936. Our stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the ticker symbol "GHM".

Our fiscal year ends on March 31 of each year. We refer to our fiscal year, which ended March 31, 2026, as fiscal 2026. Likewise, we refer to our fiscal years that will end or have ended March 31, 2027, March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2024 as fiscal 2027, fiscal 2025, and fiscal 2024, respectively.

On October 20, 2025, we completed our acquisition of Xdot Bearing Technologies ("Xdot"), a specialized consulting, design, and engineering firm focused on foil bearing technology. Xdot has been integrated into Barber-Nichols, LLC ("BN"). We believe that combining Xdot's foil bearing technology with BN's turbomachinery expertise will significantly expand our ability to design and deliver high-speed rotating machines into new markets and applications.

On January 23, 2026, we acquired FlackTek Manufacturing, LLC and FlackTek Sales, LLC (collectively, "FlackTek"), a provider of advanced mixing and material processing solutions. FlackTek's patented technology platform delivers highly repeatable, precision mixing with faster cycle times, minimal entrained air, reduced downtime between batches, consistency in production, and ultimately can achieve higher levels of product homogeneity when compared to traditional bladed methods. FlackTek's systems are used by a global customer base that includes leading original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), research and development centers, defense laboratories, and industrial manufacturers serving adhesives, sealants, functional coatings, composites, electronics, and other advanced materials markets. FlackTek adds a proven product portfolio with a shared customer base and an installed footprint that extends across the full value chain, from upstream to downstream production and quality control. Its mixing systems are process-critical and market-agnostic, serving defense, energetics, oil & gas, food, battery, aerospace and space, medical, and other industrial applications where precision, repeatability, and consistency drive value. FlackTek has built a growing installed base that generates recurring demand for consumables, accessories, and services, enhancing revenue visibility and durability.
We manufacture high quality, highly reliable custom-engineered products for critical applications to the Defense, Energy & Process and Space industries. Our product offerings include the following:
• Defense  Power plant systems - ejectors, surface condensers
 Torpedo ejection, propulsion & power systems - turbines, alternators, regulators, pumps, blowers
 Thermal management systems - pumps, blowers, drive electronics
 Advanced mixing systems - Bladeless centrifugal mixers, accessories, services, and consumables
 Heat transfer & vacuum systems - ejectors, process condensers, surface condensers, liquid ring pumps, heat exchangers, nozzles
 Power generation systems - turbines, generators, compressors, pumps  Thermal management systems - pumps, blowers, electronics

headings: Risks Related to our Business
We may experience customer concentration risk related to strategic growth for U.S. Navy projects.
The loss of, or significant reduction or delay in, purchases by our largest customers could reduce our revenue and adversely affect our results of operations.
The size of our contracts with the Defense industry, primarily the U.S. Navy, may produce volatility in short term financial results.
Defense orders are subject to annual government funding. A disruption in funding or a lapse in funding could materially and adversely impact our business.
Our efforts to expand our Defense business and changes in the competitive environment for Defense procurement could materially and adversely impact our ability to grow this portion of our business.
Contract liabilities for large Defense contracts may be beyond our normal insurance coverage and a claim could have an adverse impact on our financial results.
New technology used by the ships for the U.S. Navy may delay projects and may impact our ability to grow this portion of our business.
Our exposure to fixed-price contracts and the timely completion of such contracts could negatively impact our results of operations.
Government contracts are subject to extensive regulation and failure to comply with such regulations may have a material adverse impact on our financial condition and operating results.
Failure to comply with export, import, and sanctions laws and regulations could materially and adversely affect us.
If we fail to successfully integrate the operations of FlackTek, our financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected.
Our acquisition of FlackTek might subject us to unknown and unforeseen liabilities.
Climate change and greenhouse gas regulations may affect our customers' investment decisions.
Our reputation, ability to do business, and financial results may be materially and adversely impacted by improper conduct by any of our employees, agents or business partners.
Customer focus on short-term costs versus prioritizing quality and brand recognition, could harm our business and negatively impact our financial results.
A change in the structure of our markets, including through consolidation, could harm our business and negatively impact our financial results.
Our acquisition strategy may not be successful or may increase business risk.
We have foreign operations and a percentage of our sales occur outside of the U.S. As a result, we are subject to the economic, political, regulatory and other risks of international operations.
We are subject to foreign currency fluctuations which may adversely affect our operating results.
Our future success may be affected by indebtedness.
The operations of our subsidiary in China may be adversely affected by China's evolving economic, political and social conditions.
Intellectual property rights are difficult to enforce in China and India, which could harm our business.
Uncertainties with respect to the legal system in China may adversely affect the operations of our subsidiary in that country.
Regulation of foreign investment in India may adversely affect the operations of our Indian subsidiary.
Changes in U.S. and foreign energy policy regulations could adversely affect our business.
Near-term income statement impact from competitive contracts could adversely affect our operating results.
Our operating results could be adversely affected by customer contract cancellations and delays.
We may experience losses if we are unable to collect on our accounts receivables if our customers are unable or unwilling to pay their invoices in a timely manner or at all.

Given our size and the specialization of our business, if we lose any member of our management, technical or sales team and we experience difficulty in finding a qualified replacement, our business could be harmed.

paragraphs: The following disclosures reflect the Company's beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect the Company and our future performance and securities in the future, or could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied in our forward-looking statements. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not

intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future. Furthermore, the risks and uncertainties described below are not the only risks facing us and we cannot predict every event and circumstance that may adversely affect our business. However, these risks and uncertainties are the most significant factors that we have identified and believe at this time. If one or more of these risks actually occurs, our business, results of operations and/or financial condition could suffer, and the price of our stock could be negatively affected.

During fiscal 2026, sales to the Defense industry continued to grow and represented 60% of our business compared with 58% and 54% of sales to the Defense industry in fiscal 2025 and 2024, respectively. While these projects are spread across multiple contractors and programs, the end customer for these projects, primarily the U.S. Navy, is the same. This concentration of business could add additional risk to us should there be a disruption, short or long term, in the funding for these projects or our participation in these Defense programs.

While we may have only two customers that each represent over 10% of revenue in any single year, a small number of customers have accounted for a substantial portion of our historical net sales. For example, sales to our top ten customers, who can vary each year, accounted for 60%, 60%, and 57% of consolidated net sales in fiscal 2026, fiscal 2025, and fiscal 2024, respectively. We expect that a limited number of customers will continue to represent a substantial portion of our sales for the foreseeable future. The loss of any of our major customers, a decrease or delay in orders or anticipated spending by such customers, or a delay in the production of existing orders could materially adversely affect our revenues and results of operations.

We believe our strategy to increase the penetration of Defense related opportunities, primarily the U.S. Navy, which are often much larger contracts than our commercial contracts, can, on occasion, be delayed before or during the revenue recognition cycle. If we are unable to reallocate resources to other projects, we may see an increase in volatility in our near-term financial results that may impact our ability to effectively provide accurate investor guidance.

Efforts to reduce large U.S. federal budget deficits could result in government cutbacks or shifts in focus in Defense spending or in reduced incentives to pursue alternative energy projects, resulting in reduced demand for our products, which could harm our business and results of operations.

This management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations omits a comparative discussion regarding the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 versus the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024. Such information is located in Item 7 – Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.

Our fiscal year ends on March 31 of each year. We refer to our fiscal year, which ended March 31, 2026, as fiscal 2026. Likewise, we refer to our fiscal years that will end or have ended March 31, 2027, March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2024, as fiscal 2027, fiscal 2025, and fiscal 2024, respectively.

On October 20, 2025, we completed our acquisition of Xdot Bearing Technologies ("Xdot"), a specialized consulting, design, and engineering firm focused on foil bearing technology. Xdot has been integrated into Barber-Nichols, LLC ("BN"). We believe that combining Xdot's foil bearing technology with BN's turbomachinery expertise will significantly expand our ability to design and deliver high-speed rotating machines into new markets and applications. Xdot has annual sales of approximately $1,000 and was slightly accretive to our fiscal 2026 net income. The purchase price for this transaction consisted of cash consideration of $900 at close, subject to certain potential adjustments including a customary working capital adjustment, and was funded with cash on hand. The purchase agreement included two potential cash contingent earn-outs to be paid on the first and second anniversary of the transaction dependent upon the achievement of certain qualitative milestones totaling $600.

On January 23, 2026, we acquired FlackTek Manufacturing, LLC and FlackTek Sales, LLC (collectively, "FlackTek"), a provider of advanced mixing and material processing solutions. FlackTek's patented technology platform delivers highly repeatable, precision mixing with faster cycle times, minimal entrained air, reduced downtime between batches, consistency in production, and ultimately can achieve higher levels of product homogeneity when compared to traditional bladed methods. Its mixing systems are process-critical and market-agnostic, serving defense, energetics, oil & gas, food, battery, aerospace and space, medical, and other industrial applications where precision, repeatability, and consistency drive value. With approximately $30,000 in annualized revenue, FlackTek has built a growing installed base that generates recurring demand for consumables, accessories, and services, enhancing revenue visibility and durability.

FlackTek operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Graham Corporation, maintaining its headquarters in Louisville, CO with a satellite location in Greenville, SC, and will be integrated into Graham's financial, compliance, and operational infrastructure. Under the terms of the transaction, the Company acquired 100% of the equity of FlackTek for a purchase price of $37,022, which was comprised of cash consideration of $26,456 and 76 shares of Graham's common stock, representing a value of $5,678 at a price of $74.89 per share.

The purchase price is subject to certain potential adjustments, including a customary working capital adjustment. The purchase agreement includes the potential to earn an additional $25,000 in future performance-based cash earnouts over four years beginning with fiscal 2027, based upon achieving progressively increasing adjusted EBITDA performance targets each year. At the acquisition date, a liability of $5,638 was recorded for the contingent earn-out.
See Note 2 to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8 of Part II of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information.
Key results for fiscal 2026 include the following:

• Net sales for fiscal 2026 were $245,293, up $35,397, or 17% over the prior year, reflecting the strength of our diversified revenue base. This increase was across multiple markets, including a $25,520, or 21%, increase in sales to the Defense market, primarily due to the timing of project milestones, as well as new programs and growth in existing programs. Sales to the Energy & Process market increased $10,056, or 14%, over the prior year driven by continued momentum in New Energy markets, in particular small modular reactors ("SMRs"). Additionally, incremental revenue from the acquisition of FlackTek accounted for $2,767 of the overall net sales increase compared to the prior year and was primarily to the Energy & Process market. Aftermarket sales to the Energy & Process and Defense markets totaled $36,924 for the year, down 12% from the record levels of fiscal 2025.

• Gross profit and margin for fiscal 2026 were $57,750 and 23.5%, respectively. The 170 basis point decline in gross profit margin compared to fiscal 2025 reflects the mix of sales in fiscal 2026, and in particular, a higher level of Defense sales and material receipts, which carry a lower profit margin. The impact of increased tariffs for fiscal 2026 was approximately an incremental $1,000 compared to fiscal 2025. Additionally, fiscal 2025 gross profit benefited $1,298 due to a grant received from the BlueForge Alliance to reimburse us for the cost of our Defense welder training programs in Batavia and related equipment, which did not repeat in fiscal 2026.

paragraphs: Graham Corporation ("we," "us," "our" or the "Company") 為全球在設計與製造關鍵任務流體、動力、熱傳輸、真空及先進混合技術的領導者，應用於國防、能源與製造，以及太空產業。在國防產業中，我們的設備應用於核能與非核能推進、動力、流體傳輸、熱管理及先進混合系統。在能源與製造產業中，我們提供用於石油煉製、下游化學設施、肥料、乙烯、甲醇、能效物質、食用油、食品與飲料、紙漿與紙張、醫療以及多種替代能源應用（如氫氣、小型模組化核能、集中太陽能、鋰提取及地熱過程）的真空、熱傳輸、先進混合及流體傳輸設備。在太空產業中，我們的設備應用於推進、動力、熱管理、先進混合及生命支持系統。
我們的品牌建立在工程專業知識與緊密客戶合作之上，用以設計、開發與製造關鍵任務設備與系統，協助客戶達成其經濟與運營目標。持續改善我們的流程與系統，以確保符合標準且合格的設備，是我們品牌的特色。我們從早期與客戶合作，並持續支持至設備壽命結束，這是我們品牌價值的基礎。

本公司總部與生產設施共置於紐約州巴塔維亞（Batavia, NY），並擁有位於科羅拉多州阿瓦達（Arvada, CO）、南卡羅來納州格林維爾（Greenville, SC）、佛羅裏達州朱比特（Jupiter, FL）及科羅拉多州路易斯維爾（Louisville, CO）的 wholly-owned 子公司，並在德克薩斯州休士頓（Houston, TX）、中國蘇州（Suzhou, China）及印度艾哈邁達巴德（Ahmedabad）與浦那（Pune）設有銷售與工程辦事處。
本公司於1983年在特拉華州註冊成立，為 Graham Manufacturing Co., Inc. 的繼承者，而 Graham Manufacturing Co., Inc. 於1936年在紐約州註冊成立。本公司股票於紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）交易，股票代碼為 "GHM"。
本公司會計年度於每年3月31日結束。我們將會計年度，即於2026年3月31日結束的會計年度，稱為財務2026年。同樣地，我們將於2027年3月31日結束或已結束的會計年度，以及2025年3月31日及2024年3月31日的會計年度，分別稱為財務2027年、財務2025年及財務2024年。
於2025年10月20日，本公司完成收購 Xdot Bearing Technologies（"Xdot"），一家專注於箔 bearing 技術的諮詢、設計與工程公司。Xdot 已整合至 Barber-Nichols, LLC（"BN"）。我們認為，將 Xdot 的箔 bearing 技術與 BN 的渦輪機械專業結合，將大幅拓展我們設計與交付高速旋轉機械至新市場與應用的能力。

於2026年1月23日，本公司收購 FlackTek Manufacturing, LLC 及 FlackTek Sales, LLC（合稱 "FlackTek"），一家提供先進混合與材料加工解決方案的公司。FlackTek 的專利技術平台可提供高度重複性、精準混合，並具較快的週期時間、較少的氣泡、較短的批次間停機時間、生產一致性，最終可達成較傳統葉片方法更高的產品均質度。FlackTek 的系統被全球客戶使用，包括領先的原廠設備製造商（"OEMs"）、研究與發展中心、國防實驗室及工業製造商，服務黏合劑、密封劑、功能性塗層、複合材料、電子產品及其他先進材料市場。FlackTek 增加了一個已證實的產品組合，與共同客戶羣及安裝基礎，覆蓋從上游至下游生產與品質控制的完整價值鏈。其混合系統為過程關鍵且市場中立，服務國防、能效物質、石油與天然氣、食品、電池、航空與太空、醫療及其他工業應用，其中精準、重複性與一致性驅動價值。FlackTek 已建立一個成長中的安裝基礎，產生對消耗品、配件與服務的持續需求，提高收入可見度與穩定性。
我們製造高品質、高度可靠且客製化工程的產品，應用於國防、能源與製造及太空產業。我們的產品組合包括以下內容：
• 防禦  動力設施系統 - 噴射器、表面冷凝器
 鱷魚彈射、推進與動力系統 - 水輪機、交流發電機、調壓器、泵、風機
 熱能管理系統 - 泵、風機、驅動電子組件
 先進混合系統 - 無葉片離心混合器、配件、服務及消耗品
 熱傳導與真空系統 - 噴射器、過程冷凝器、表面冷凝器、液環泵、熱交換器、噴嘴
 動力發電系統 - 水輪機、發電機、壓縮機、泵  熱能管理系統 - 泵、風機、電子組件

本管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運結果的內容，未包含比較財政年度終結於2025年3月31日與財政年度終結於2024年3月31日的資料。相關資訊請參閱我們2025年財政年度終結於2025年3月31日的年度報告（Form 10-K）第7項「管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運結果」。
本公司財政年度於每年3月31日結束。我們將財政年度終結於2026年3月31日稱為財政2026年。同樣地，我們將財政年度終結於2027年3月31日、2025年3月31日及2024年3月31日分別稱為財政2027年、財政2025年及財政2024年。

2025年10月20日，本公司完成收購Xdot Bearing Technologies（"Xdot"），一家專注於箔片軸承技術的諮詢、設計與工程公司。Xdot已整合至Barber-Nichols, LLC（"BN"）。我們相信，將Xdot的箔片軸承技術與BN的渦輪機械專業結合，將大幅拓展我們設計與交付高速旋轉機械至新市場與應用的能力。Xdot年營收約為1,000美元，對財政2026年淨收入略為正面影響。此交易的購併價格包含於交易完成時支付的現金900美元，視某些潛在調整（包括常見的營運資金調整）而定，並以現金支付。購併協議包含兩筆潛在現金條件式 earn-out，於交易後第一及第二個年度支付，視達成某些質性里程碑而定，總計為600美元。

2026年1月23日，本公司收購FlackTek Manufacturing, LLC與FlackTek Sales, LLC（合稱"FlackTek"），一家提供先進混合與材料處理解決方案的公司。FlackTek的專利技術平台可提供高度重複性、精準混合，並具較短週期時間、極少氣泡、減少批次間停機時間、生產一致性，最終可達成較傳統葉片方法更高的產品均質度。FlackTek的系統被全球客戶使用，包括領先的原廠設備製造商（"OEMs"）、研究與發展中心、防禦實驗室及工業製造商，服務黏合劑、密封劑、功能性塗層、複合材料、電子及其它先進材料市場。FlackTek增加了一個已驗證的產品組合，與共享客戶羣及安裝基礎，其範圍橫跨整個價值鏈，從上游至下游生產與品質控制。其混合系統為流程關鍵且市場中立，服務防禦、能效物質、石油與天然氣、食品、電池、航空航天與太空、醫療及其他工業應用，其中精準、重複性與一致性驅動價值。FlackTek年營收約為30,000美元，已建立一個成長中的安裝基礎，產生對消耗品、配件與服務的持續需求，提高營收可見度與穩定性。

FlackTek 係 Graham Corporation 的 wholly owned subsidiary，總部設於 Colorado 的 Louisville，並在 South Carolina 的 Greenville 設有衛星辦公室，將整合至 Graham 的財務、合規與運營基礎設施。根據交易條款，本公司以總價 37,022 美元取得 FlackTek 全部股權，其中現金對價為 26,456 美元，以及 76 張 Graham 普通股，每股 74.89 美元，總價值為 5,678 美元。
買取價格可能根據某些潛在調整項目進行調整，包括慣常的營運資金調整。買取協議包含未來四年內，自財務2027年起，根據每年達成逐漸提高的調整後EBITDA績效目標，有機會獲得額外25,000美元的績效基於現金 earnouts 的潛在權利。在取得日，已針對潛在 earn-out 記錄了5,638美元的負債。
請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表二（Item 8 of Part II）所附的合併財務明細表，以取得更多資訊。
財務年度 2026 的關鍵結果如下：

• 財務年度 2026 的淨銷售額為 245,293 美元，較前一年增加 35,397 美元，或成長 17%，反映本公司多元化收入基礎的強勢。此成長遍及多個市場，包括對防禦市場的銷售增加 25,520 美元，或成長 21%，主要由於專案里程碑的時程，以及新專案與現有專案的成長。對能源與流程市場的銷售增加 10,056 美元，或成長 14%，主要由於新能源市場持續成長，特別是小型模組反應爐（"SMRs"）。此外，來自 FlackTek 收購的增量收入佔整體淨銷售額成長的 2,767 美元，主要為能源與流程市場。能源與流程及防禦市場的後市場銷售總計為 36,924 美元，較財務年度 2025 的歷史高點下降 12%。

• 財務年度 2026 的毛利為 57,750 美元，毛利率為 23.5%。與財務年度 2025 相較，毛利率下降 170 基點，反映財務年度 2026 的銷售組成，特別是防禦市場銷售與材料進貨比例提高，這些產品的毛利較低。財務年度 2026 的關稅增加對毛利的影響約為 1,000 美元，較財務年度 2025 增加。此外，財務年度 2025 的毛利因獲得 BlueForge Alliance 的補助金，用以補償我們在 Batavia 的防禦焊接訓練課程及相關設備的成本，總計為 1,298 美元，此補助在財務年度 2026 未重複出現。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
我們可能因美國海軍專案的戰略成長而面臨客戶集中風險。
我們最大客戶的流失，或其購買量顯著減少或延遲，可能會降低我們的營業收入，並對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。
我們與防禦產業，主要是美國海軍所簽訂的合約規模，可能會導致短期財務結果出現波動。
防禦訂單受年度政府經費影響。經費中斷或經費停擺可能會對我們的業務產生重大且不利的影響。
我們努力拓展防禦業務，以及防禦採購領域的競爭環境變化，可能會對我們擴展此業務部分的能力產生重大且不利的影響。
大型防禦合約的合約負債可能超出我們正常的保險範圍，並可能對我們的財務結果產生不利影響。
美國海軍艦艇所使用的新技術可能會延遲專案，並可能影響我們擴展此業務部分的能力。
本公司對固定價格合約之敞口及如期完成該等合約之能力，可能對本公司營運成果產生負面影響。
政府合約受廣泛規範，未能遵守相關規範可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
未能遵守出口、進口及制裁法規，可能對本公司產生重大且不利影響。
若本公司未能成功整合 FlackTek 之營運，本公司財務狀況及營運成果可能受到不利影響。
本公司收購 FlackTek 可能使本公司面臨未知且未預見之負債。
氣候變遷及溫室氣體規範可能影響本公司客戶之投資決策。
本公司聲譽、營運能力及財務成果可能因本公司員工、代理人或商業夥伴之不當行為而產生重大且不利影響。
客戶過度重視短期成本而非優先考量品質與品牌認知，可能損害本公司業務，並對本公司財務成果產生負面影響。
市場結構的變動，包括透過併購，可能損害本公司業務並對財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司收購策略可能無法成功，或可能增加業務風險。
本公司有海外營運，且銷售收入的一部分發生在美國以外地區。因此，本公司面臨國際營運的經濟、政治、法規及其他風險。
本公司面臨外幣波動，可能對營運結果產生負面影響。
本公司未來的成功可能受到負債的影響。
本公司中國子公司營運可能因中國經濟、政治及社會環境的變化而受到負面影響。
智慧財產權在中國及印度難以執行，可能損害本公司業務。
中國法律制度的不確定性可能對本公司在該國的子公司營運產生負面影響。
印度對外資規範可能不利於本公司印度子公司之營運。
美國及外國能源政策規範之變更可能不利於本公司業務。
競爭性契約所導致之短期損益影響可能不利於本公司營運結果。
本公司營運結果可能因客戶契約取消或延遲而受到不利影響。
若本公司無法收帳，且客戶無法或不願及時或完全支付應付款項，本公司可能產生損失。
考量本公司規模及業務之專業化，若本公司失去任一管理、技術或銷售團隊成員，且難以尋獲合格之替代人選，本公司業務可能受損。
若本公司成為產品責任、保固或其他聲請之對象，本公司營運結果可能受影響
paragraphs: 下列揭露反映本公司對可能重大且不利影響本公司及其未來表現與證券之因素之信念與意見，或可能導致實際結果與本公司所表達或暗示之預測性陳述有所差異之因素。對過往事件之提及僅為範例，並非完整清單，亦不代表這些因素是否已過往發生或未來發生之可能性。
此外，下列所描述之風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險，本公司無法預測所有可能對本公司業務產生不利影響之事件與情勢。然而，這些風險與不確定性為本公司目前所識別之最重要因素，且本公司認為在目前時點為最關鍵之因素。若其中一個或多個風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果與/或財務狀況造成影響，並可能對本公司股票價格產生負面影響。
在財務年度2026年，銷售至國防產業持續成長，佔本公司營業額之60%，相較於財務年度2025年與2024年分別為58%與54%。雖然這些專案分散於多個承包商與計畫，但這些專案之最終客戶，主要為美國海軍，為同一客戶。此業務集中度若發生這些專案資金中斷，短或長期，或本公司參與這些國防計畫之情況，將可能增加本公司之風險。

雖然我們可能在任一年僅有兩家客戶，每家客戶的營業收入均超過10%，但少數客戶已佔我們歷史淨銷售額的相當大比例。例如，銷售給我們前十大客戶（這些客戶每年可能不同），在財務年度2026年、財務年度2025年及財務年度2024年，分別佔合併淨銷售額的60%、60%及57%。我們預期，在可預見的未來，仍將有少數客戶佔據我們銷售額的相當大比例。若失去任何主要客戶，或這些客戶訂單減少或延遲，或預期支出減少或延遲，或現有訂單生產延遲，可能會對我們的營收及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
我們認為，我們增加防禦相關機會的策略，主要為美國海軍，這些機會通常比我們的商業合約大得多，有時可能在收入確認週期前或期間延遲。若我們無法將資源重新分配至其他專案，我們可能會看到短期財務結果的波動增加，這可能會影響我們有效提供準確投資者指引的能力。
減少美國聯邦預算赤字的努力，可能會導致政府在防禦支出上進行裁減或轉移重點，或減少推動替代能源專案的動機，進而導致我們產品需求減少，這可能會對我們的業務及營運成果造成損害。
